note: Evidence manifest for the determinism-certification packages whose writeups live in this directory: the tp=4 hinge (TP4HINGE_SUMMARY.txt), the tp=8 dense hinge (TP8HINGE_SUMMARY.txt) and MoE-at-tp=8 (MOETP8_SUMMARY.md). OWNERSHIP RULE: a tracked file belongs to exactly one manifest -- the nearest enclosing directory that carries an EVIDENCE.json. This manifest therefore also covers dojoinit_recovery_2026-08-18/, hwprobe_archive/ and runs/flip_nemotron-3-nano-4b/, and deliberately does NOT re-pin runs/regime_mean_2026-08-21/ or the tarball FILES under uncommitted_evidence_preserved_2026-08-22/ -- each has its own manifest. TARBALL MEMBERS: entries of the form tarball:<archive>!<member> name evidence that exists only inside a preserved scratchpad tarball. Only the load-bearing members are listed by name; every other member is still integrity-covered, because the archive's own sha256 is pinned in uncommitted_evidence_preserved_2026-08-22/EVIDENCE.json.
